description: Implementation of PermissionDao interface for managing Permission entities, including methods for listing permissions, retrieving by ID, fetching permissions by group IDs, and listing permissions based on criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Permission entity, providing data access methods.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all permissions ordered by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches permissions associated with specified group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions based on specified criteria, including group IDs and pagination.
